title: Stronger v2 guarantee: eventual 4N with Big-O N^(4/5) remainder for the certificate-prefix BK family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let h(n)=n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent with the exact parameters in guarantee.remainder. There exist a fixed real K>0 and N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-K*h(n) for every integer n>=N. K is existential, not a specified coefficient. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total certificate-prefix language F defined completely in proof.md and family.py. At actual length N, let k be the least prime at least the least positive integer B with B^5>32*N^3; read k input bits as the low coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject Q unless the explicit Frobenius/gcd irreducibility test passes, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 at N=0 and at every explicitly stated failed guard. The result is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. Every prefix bit is included in N; Q is input, not advice.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"exponent":{"denominator":"5","numerator":"4"},"kind":"big_o","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This one fixed total language is in P, hence in NP with empty witnesses. In the full pinned Li--Yang B2 model there exist a fixed real K>0 and an integer N0 such that C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-K*N^(4/5) for EVERY integer N>=N0. More precisely, the proof displays R(N)=4*k+10*(floor(k*r/t)+k*t+r*(r+1)+1), proves C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-R(N) eventually, and bounds that same R(N) by K*N^(4/5). K and N0 depend only on the fixed theorem. Consequently C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-o(N) and liminf_N C_B2(F_N)/N>=4.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact checks of pair-line Boolean identities, all Revision-1 potential estimates, integer dimension/final accounting, prime-degree prefix tests, weighted block isolation, and executable family evaluation. Universal proof coverage is in the Markdown evidence.
